title: elevation-only probes are denied: unknown(permission), not 'nothing found'
titleZh: 需要提权的探针被拒:unknown(权限被拒),不是「没找到」
why: MEASURED on the reference machine: non-elevated Get-NetConnectionProfile and powercfg /requests are refused outright. A refusal carries no information about the machine's state, so the verdict must be unknown with the denial attached - claiming 'no rule / not configured' would be a fabricated answer. The registry-based firewall check must still work, because that is exactly why the collector prefers it.
inject: the admin-only cmdlet and powercfg query replaced by an access-denied result; the netsh fallback removed as well
expectSummary: NIC unknown/nic_probe_failed, POWER unknown/power_unparsed, FIREWALL_PROFILES still pass from the registry, exit != 0
